doc_text: choosing a nursing home is hard.  a year ago my grandmother was living alone in her house and as the dementia was getting worse we began the process of looking for a memory care facility.  we toured several and none of the options were great.  then grandma fell and broke both her arms and we were forced to find an acute rehab facility that also had memory care capabilities.  the list of options is short, and we selected marquis.  i cannot recommend them enough.  the food sure wasn't great but that's the only negative thing i could say.  the staff is absolutely amazing.  they were able to prevent my grandmother from needing the memory care protections by simply interacting with her.  they were able to help this fiercely independent woman transition to a situation that she never wanted to be in, and to thrive in that space.  during the covid pandemic they were very accomodating about zoom calls and facetime to replace in-person visits, and did everything right to prevent covid from entering the facility.  my grandmother had a heart attack last  week and moved to hospice.  due to covid they would only allow two visitors in total, so my sister and i spent 40 hours at my grandmother's bedside.  the staff was so caring and supportive it was incredible - especially catherine and kayla.  the whole team made this difficult period much easier and my very grateful to how great they treated my grandmother.  i cannot recommend this place enough!

i came to innovative express care because my primary was moving here. i feel like it is very important to write honest reviews, especially when it comes to your health. i have been unfortunate enough to experience some not so great healthcare, and it has made me very much appreciate how attentive and caring innovative express care is. i see jenna benoit, pa-c, for primary care and have been seeing her for many years. i am really happy that jenna decided to move here because it feels like it runs on an integrated care model. they are expanding to offer wellness through ketamine infusion, cbd oil, among others. they also have an innovative med spa which i also think is great. the way they've branched out is impressed and i enjoy that they keep the same type of model. their patient portal is very easy to use and tracks your health in one setting. i am able to easily send messages and ask about prescriptions. they also have telemedicine which is helpful for when i don't need to come in/am busy. they have social workers here, too, so you can receive therapy. again, definitely feels like an integrated healthcare model being used. 

aside from going here for my primary care, i have gone to their urgent care on several occasions. my primary is kind, caring, and patient with me; she knows me well but doesn't get annoyed when i reach out, make requests, or send her many messages. as a person with anxiety, this is special to met because it helps me feel at ease. i've had the opportunity to receive care from jayme, michelle, and lindsay (all pas) in the past when i had to come in for urgent care and they were all really wonderful and kind. kindness goes a long way and it extends to their nurses who've always said hi to me and made me feel welcomed and comfortable. there was a period of time where i had to come in a few times a week or once a week and everyone from the nurses to the receptionists have always been welcoming. i definitely appreciate innovative express care and their staff; i encourage everyone to come here! be mindful that if you're coming for urgent care, you're definitely going to have to wait. it's just how it is, but i've never waited for urgent care more than 15-20 minutes; make an appointment online ahead of time is the best suggestion!
